newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares seen lacklustre, spotlight on TELCO.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares seen lacklustre, spotlight on TELCO.

text.p: ** Bombay shares are likely to trade narrowly in lacklustre trade with the spotlight shifting to leading truckmaker TELCO, traders say
** TELCO is expected to announce a 35 percent increase in net profit to some 7.2 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March), from 5.3 billion in the previous year

** Traders say sellers will continue to hammer stocks of largest private steelmaker TISCO, integrated petrochemicals firm IPCL and truckmaker Eicher Motors after disappointing results from the three firms
** Delay in petroleum product price hike has been taken negatively by the market, they say
** Earnings also due from Hero Honda and Indian Shaving
